jobs.title: Technical Enterprise Account Manager - Payments
jobs.description:
***Company Description***

*We’re**Checkout.com**. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.*

*We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.*  
  
*Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.*  
  
*If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*  
  
*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*

**Job description:**

As a Enterprise Technical Account Management (TAM), you will be instrumental in building and maintaining strategic relationships with key clients, ensuring their satisfaction by resolving their technical issues, optimizing their payment solutions and delivering exceptional service with your technical expertise and strong interpersonal skills.

* **This posting covers multiple openings across locations and seniorities.** Your exact leveling + compensation range will be determined by your location, experience and interview performance.

* **This role hybrid role, going into the office 3 days a week** (hybrid), at our SF (Jackson Square), NYC (Chelsea), and Atlanta (Colony Square) location. **Please note that unfortunately, we do not offer relocation assistance for this role at this time.**

  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

**Strategic Growth & Performance**

* Become a true expert on your merchants’ business, diving deep into their payment data to uncover actionable insights and opportunities.
* Act as a payment performance consultant, identifying and driving initiatives that boost authorization rates, increase revenue, and lead to the adoption of new Checkout.com products.
* Serve as a strategic advisor during business reviews, translating technical performance into a compelling commercial story for your merchants.

**Technical Ownership & Delivery**

* Serve as the primary technical authority for your merchants, mastering their API integrations and infrastructure.
* Lead the response to critical incidents with a calm, decisive approach, coordinating internal teams to ensure swift resolution and clear communication.
* Project-manage key technical initiatives, from complex migrations to new product launches, ensuring seamless, on-time delivery.

**Merchant Advocacy & Enablement**

* Act as the voice of the merchant internally, translating their needs and feedback into clear insights that help shape our product roadmap.
* Empower your merchants by delivering expert training, workshops, and demos to ensure they are leveraging the full power of our platform.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in a senior, client-facing technical role such as Technical Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or Sales Engineering, preferably within a SaaS or API-first company.
* Solid understanding of the end-to-end payment lifecycle, from authorization to settlement. **Payments experience + knowledge is required.**
* A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Hands-on expertise with RESTful APIs. You can confidently read API documentation, troubleshoot integration issues, and guide developers through complex workflows.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to build trust and convey complex technical subjects to both C-level executives and engineering teams.
* A natural problem-solver with a tenacious attitude; you're comfortable navigating ambiguity and leading clients through high-pressure technical incidents.

**What makes you stand out:**

* Deep knowledge of core payment concepts like SCA, Tokenization, MIT/CIT, AFT/OCT, and the technical drivers of authorization rate optimization.
* Direct experience with payments ecosystem, including knowledge of key local payment methods and acquiring capabilities
* Fluency in other languages is an advantage.

**Additional Information**

**Bring all of you to work**

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

**Life at** **Checkout.com**

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Compensation Range: $122K - $206.9K

Our software helps the world's largest energy consumers achieve faster, cheaper, and cleaner power by combining real-time control of energy assets with complete visibility into their energy portfolio. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, GV, Coatue, and NVIDIA, and built by pioneers in grid-scale batteries, energy markets, and enterprise software, we're redefining how the world's most ambitious organizations access and manage energy.

We're hiring a **Customer Success Manager** to own the relationship and commercial outcomes for a portfolio of enterprise energy buyers after they sign. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role for someone who knows renewable energy procurement inside and out and can be a trusted advisor to sophisticated energy and sustainability teams from day one.

You'll join a lean, fast-moving Customer Success function and help shape how it operates as we scale. A key part of this role is growing with Verse into **dispatch intelligence and battery storage optimization** real-time products that will define the next chapter of the platform. You'll be the person who makes sure our customers adopt the platform, realize value, renew, and grow.

* **Drive** **revenue** **retention**lead renewals, protect gross retention, and identify and close in-footprint expansion.
* **Serve as a trusted energy advisor****,** guiding customers on PPA/VPPA portfolio management, invoice and settlement validation, generation forecasting, availability and production guarantees, and REC/EAC management.
* **Run executive business reviews**, build account health scoring, and manage senior stakeholder relationships up the org chart.
* **Translate the platform's analytical outputs**into clear business value and confident reporting for your customers.
* **Partner cross-****functionally**with Sales on closed-won transitions and expansion, with Delivery on onboarding and implementation quality, and with Product to channel voice-of-customer into the roadmap.
* **Be a driving force in Verse's move into real-time dispatch intelligence and battery storage optimization** a central part of this role as those products scale.
* **Own your metrics**revenue retention, renewal rate, customer health, and referenceable customers.

### **What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* **4+ years**in customer success, account management, or client-facing advisory/consulting — ideally in energy, cleantech, or enterprise SaaS.
* **Deep, working knowledge of renewable energy procurement:**PPAs/VPPAs, RECs/EACs, and wholesale power markets (e.g., ERCOT, PJM, MISO, SPP).
* **A track record**managing large enterprise relationships and owning retention and expansion outcomes.
* **Comfort with data and analytics** able to interrogate technical outputs and turn them into a business narrative.
* **Outstanding executive communication****,** and the instinct to ask the probing questions that surface what a customer actually needs.
* **A builder's mindset**comfortable operating with ambiguity in a startup, and willing to travel to customers (~20–30%).
* **Bonus:**exposure to real-time energy markets, dispatch optimization, battery storage, or energy trading; a background in energy advisory or asset management; or experience helping stand up a customer success function.

### **What Makes Verse a Great Place to Work?**

* Lead with Empathy: We lift each other up with humility and kindness, always putting colleagues and customers first
* Be Honest & Transparent: We prioritize effective communication to build trust with our team, customers, and stakeholders
* Move with Balance & Precision: We believe speed and perseverance must be accompanied by thoughtfulness and reflection
* Leave the World a Better Place: We are passionate about our mission, and we strive to create a sustainable world for future generations

### **Base Pay Range**

**$115,000 - $150,000**

This is the estimated base salary range for this position, which does not include the value of benefits or a potential equity grant. A wide range of factors are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to level, skill sets, market conditions, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and business and organizational needs.

jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We're redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall's AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We've built a product customers love and a business that's scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.

At Aircall, you'll join a company in motion. We're ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  

**How we work at Aircall**: We're customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you'll feel at home here.

**Why Aircall, Why Now**
------------------------

Help turn a trusted telco brand into a recognizable AI voice product, one event at a time. Rare opportunity, big impact: a startup mindset on top of an established, strong foundation. Aircall is a trusted cloud-based phone solution, with over a decade of global reach across tens of thousands of customers. Over the last year, we've built on that foundation and developed an incredible agentic offering, Voice Agents and Messaging Agents, that helps customers accelerate their AI strategy with an end-to-end, omni-channel voice solution. As we move away from inbound paid search, events are one of the main ways we build pipeline and move the brand forward across the US and Canada. This role makes those events happen.

**About the Role**
------------------

Aircall is looking for an experienced Event Coordinator to join our Field Marketing team and run the planning, logistics, and execution behind our events across the US and Canada.

You will be the person who makes events happen: from executive dinners and roadshows to partner events and larger flagship moments. You will work alongside Field Marketing, Sales, Account Management, and Partnerships counterparts, as well as Performance Marketing, Creative, and Content, so that every event ties to pipeline and brand goals.

We are looking for someone organized, hands-on, and calm under pressure, who takes pride in events that run smoothly and deliver results.  
This role will be hybrid from either our New York or San Franscisco office.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Plan and run events end to end**: coordinate executive dinners, roadshows, partner events, customer events, and larger flagship moments, from first brief to post-event wrap-up.
* **Own the logistics**: manage venues, catering, AV, travel, shipping, signage, and swag, and build run-of-show documents and checklists for every event.
* **Manage vendors and venues**: source, negotiate with, and manage agencies and vendors, and hold them to budget and quality.
* **Track the budget**: monitor spend against each event budget, manage invoices and POs, and flag overruns early.
* **Drive attendance**: manage invitations, registration, and guest lists with Sales, Account Management, and Partnerships so the right accounts are in the room.
* **Be on site**: run events on the ground, including some travel across the US and Canada.
* **Close the loop**: capture attendance and lead data in Salesforce and our marketing automation platform, support timely follow-up with Sales, and report on event results.
* **Work with Creative and Content**: brief event assets, signage, and collateral, and keep event messaging consistent with the brand.
* **Build the playbook**: document processes, templates, and lessons learned so events get easier to run and repeat.
* **Support customer story and partner programs**: help with events that showcase customers and partners.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3 to 5+ years in event coordination, event marketing, or event production, ideally in B2B SaaS or technology.
* A track record of running events of different sizes, from small executive dinners to large conferences or trade shows.
* Strong vendor and venue management skills, including negotiating quotes and managing contracts.
* Comfort tracking budgets, invoices, and POs against event plans.
* Excellent organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage several events at once.
* Clear, confident communication with Sales, Account Management, partners, and external vendors.
* Experience with Salesforce and a marketing automation platform such as HubSpot or Marketo. Event platforms such as Cvent, Eventbrite, or Splash are a plus.
* Calm and resourceful on site, with a bias for solving problems quickly.
* Willingness to travel for events (roughly 20-30%, to be confirmed).
* A plus: experience with events in Canada, or a background in AI, voice, CCaaS, or telco.

**Why join us?**

Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities

‍️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall

Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit

45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset

Competitive salary package & benefits

**About JOLT**

  

JOLT is a global digital out-of-home (DOOH) and electric vehicle charging company, operating across Australia, the UK, Canada, and New Zealand, and now expanding into the United States.

We combine EV charging infrastructure with premium digital media, connecting brands with people in high-attention, real-world locations such as retail, dining, and urban streets, while supporting everyday charging needs for drivers.

In 2026, JOLT entered the US through the acquisition of a substantial portion of the Volta Media Network from Shell, adding thousands of charging and media sites across major US markets. This is a rare opportunity to join a growing global business at a pivotal moment and help build its next chapter in the US.

The Account Manager (AM) is a core member of JOLT's U.S. Advertising team, working side by side with Sellers and acting as the bridge between Sales, clients, agencies, programmatic partners and operations as our U.S. business grows.

You will manage campaigns from pre-sale through post-campaign, spot new opportunities in the data, upsell, and deliver flawless execution and exceptional service across direct and programmatic channels. You will be in front of clients and agencies regularly, joining pitches, proposal sessions and campaign reviews alongside the sales team.

We want someone hungry to grow revenue and their own career, who leans in on AI tools to work smarter. * Lead client wrap-up conversations and bring growth ideas into every review.

***Company Description***

*We’re**Checkout.com**. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.*

*We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.*  
  
*Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.*  
  
*If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*  
  
*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*

**Job description:**

As a Enterprise Technical Account Management (TAM), you will be instrumental in building and maintaining strategic relationships with key clients, ensuring their satisfaction by resolving their technical issues, optimizing their payment solutions and delivering exceptional service with your technical expertise and strong interpersonal skills.

* **This posting covers multiple openings across locations and seniorities.** Your exact leveling + compensation range will be determined by your location, experience and interview performance.

* **This role hybrid role, going into the office 3 days a week** (hybrid), at our SF (Jackson Square), NYC (Chelsea), and Atlanta (Colony Square) location. **Please note that unfortunately, we do not offer relocation assistance for this role at this time.**

  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

**Strategic Growth & Performance**

* Become a true expert on your merchants’ business, diving deep into their payment data to uncover actionable insights and opportunities.
* Act as a payment performance consultant, identifying and driving initiatives that boost authorization rates, increase revenue, and lead to the adoption of new Checkout.com products.
* Serve as a strategic advisor during business reviews, translating technical performance into a compelling commercial story for your merchants.

**Technical Ownership & Delivery**

* Serve as the primary technical authority for your merchants, mastering their API integrations and infrastructure.
* Lead the response to critical incidents with a calm, decisive approach, coordinating internal teams to ensure swift resolution and clear communication.
* Project-manage key technical initiatives, from complex migrations to new product launches, ensuring seamless, on-time delivery.

**Merchant Advocacy & Enablement**

* Act as the voice of the merchant internally, translating their needs and feedback into clear insights that help shape our product roadmap.
* Empower your merchants by delivering expert training, workshops, and demos to ensure they are leveraging the full power of our platform.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in a senior, client-facing technical role such as Technical Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or Sales Engineering, preferably within a SaaS or API-first company.
* Solid understanding of the end-to-end payment lifecycle, from authorization to settlement. **Payments experience + knowledge is required.**
* A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Hands-on expertise with RESTful APIs. You can confidently read API documentation, troubleshoot integration issues, and guide developers through complex workflows.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to build trust and convey complex technical subjects to both C-level executives and engineering teams.
* A natural problem-solver with a tenacious attitude; you're comfortable navigating ambiguity and leading clients through high-pressure technical incidents.

**What makes you stand out:**

* Deep knowledge of core payment concepts like SCA, Tokenization, MIT/CIT, AFT/OCT, and the technical drivers of authorization rate optimization.
* Direct experience with payments ecosystem, including knowledge of key local payment methods and acquiring capabilities
* Fluency in other languages is an advantage.

**Additional Information**

**Bring all of you to work**

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

**Life at** **Checkout.com**

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

---------------

Trusted by more startups around the world, AWS makes the power of cloud computing accessible for all by giving founders everywhere access to the same technology that powers the world’s largest companies. As AWS continues to rapidly grow, we seek a Startup Account Manager to earn trust and help drive growth amongst a set of well-funded, high-potential startups.
  
  
Startups represent a critically important subset of customers to AWS. These companies have unique needs, technical considerations, sales cycles, and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional companies. These businesses require different engagement strategies and sales motions from sellers to effectively acquire, grow, and retain them on the AWS platform long-term.
  
  
The ideal candidate possesses strong sales acumen, knowledge of the startup ecosystem, and a passion for (and familiarity with) AI/ML. You will be working with startups building innovative solutions, so extensive collaboration with both external and internal teams will be key to build and execute on plans to meet and exceed sales quota. Your responsibilities will include driving revenue, accelerating innovation through service adoption, and ensuring these startups select AWS as their primary cloud provider. You will work closely with product and service teams, business development, marketing, solution architecture and partner teams to drive customer outcomes.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Ensure customer success with early and mid stage startups
* Drive revenue and market share in a defined territory or industry vertical
* Accelerate customer adoption through well-developed sales engagements and successful GTM Strategy
* Meet or exceed quarterly revenue and goal targets.
* Develop and execute against a comprehensive account/territory plan.
* Create & articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

jobs.description:
Executive Assistant
===================

**Location**

1 Smith Street, Brooklyn, NY 11201 (on-site five days per week)

**Reports To**

Executive Director & Chief of Staff

**About The HOPE Program**

The HOPE Program (HOPE) empowers New Yorkers to build stronger futures through comprehensive training, employment, career advancement, and lifelong support. For forty years, HOPE has stood as a pillar for individuals facing systemic barriers to economic opportunity.

Our vision of a Home Of Prosperity and Empowerment goes beyond traditional job placement. We prepare participants for meaningful, sustainable careers while working to address systemic challenges in underserved neighborhoods. Through our signature workforce development initiatives and holistic support services, we empower individuals to overcome unemployment, underemployment, and financial instability — creating lasting change for themselves and their communities.

Our employees embody HOPE’s core values—Heart, Opportunity, Purpose-Driven, and Excellence—by embracing a growth mindset, showing empathy, and remaining deeply committed to the individuals we serve. We are committed to breaking the cycles of poverty and exclusion that impact so many in our city.

**Position Summary**

The Executive Assistant is a trusted partner to the Executive Director and senior leadership team. The role keeps leadership organized and moving: managing the Executive Director's calendar and correspondence, preparing for meetings, tracking follow-ups, and supporting board and funder engagement. The Executive Assistant is also a welcoming first point of contact for HOPE: greeting all stakeholders who visit our main site, connecting them to the right people, and managing the main phone line and mail. The Executive Assistant notices what needs to happen, connects the Executive Director's office with teams across HOPE, and takes initiative without waiting to be asked. The role reports to the Executive Director and the Chief of Staff and works closely with the senior leadership team. This is a great opportunity for a motivated recent college graduate who wants to grow in nonprofit leadership, and a strong fit for someone with proven executive or administrative support experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

#### **Executive Director Support**

* Manage the Executive Director's calendar, scheduling, and meeting coordination, balancing priorities and protecting time for strategic work.
* Manage the Executive Director's correspondence: sort her inbox and mail, flag urgent items, draft replies, letters, and thank-you notes, and follow each item through to completion.
* Prepare the Executive Director for each day and week with agendas, briefing notes, and background materials.
* Coordinate the Executive Director's external meetings, events, and travel.
* Collect and submit the Executive Director's receipts and expense reports on time.

#### **Senior Leadership Team Support**

* Schedule senior leadership team meetings, prepare agendas, take notes, and track decisions and action items.
* Follow up with leaders on deadlines and action items, and remind owners before items slip.
* Create and maintain trackers, shared calendars, and records for leadership priorities.
* Support senior leaders with scheduling, document preparation, and special projects as needed.

#### **Executive Office Operations**

* Keep the Executive Director's files, documents, and shared drives organized and easy to find.
* Route documents for review, approval, and signature, and track them to completion.
* Serve as a link between the Executive Director's office and staff across departments, so information and requests get to the right place quickly.
* Partner with the Operations team on logistics for leadership meetings, board meetings, and events.
* Coordinate funder visits, site tours, and partner meetings, including scheduling, materials, and follow-up.
* Keep contact lists and records for funders and key partners up to date.

#### **Visitor Welcome, Main Phone Line & Mail**

* Greet all stakeholders who visit HOPE's main site, including participants, board members, funders, partners, and community members, and connect them to the right staff member or resource.
* Manage HOPE's main phone line: answer calls, review voicemail daily, and route messages to the right staff the same day.
* Manage mail for the main site: receive, sort, and distribute incoming mail and packages, and send outgoing mail.
* Prepare for visits from guests of the Executive Director and senior leadership, so each visit runs smoothly.
* Provide backup coverage at the front desk when needed, in coordination with the Operations team.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree, executive or administrative support experience, or both. Recent college graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Experience supporting a senior leader, or managing a busy calendar and inbox, is a plus.
* Strong judgment and discretion with confidential information, including board, personnel, and financial matters.
* A self-starting mindset, with a habit of anticipating needs and solving problems before they grow.
* Excellent written communication skills, including drafting professional emails and letters.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities for several leaders.
* A warm, professional presence, in person and on the phone, with participants, board members, funders, and partners.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace, especially Excel or Sheets. Salesforce experience is a plus; we will train the right candidate.
* Commitment to HOPE's mission of advancing economic mobility through green careers.
* Spanish or another language spoken by HOPE participants is a plus.

**Work Environment**

* This position works on site at HOPE's main office five days per week; the work schedule may occasionally include early morning or evening hours for meetings and events.

At Maxair, we strive to cultivate a workplace where individuals find fulfillment in their work and build meaningful connections with each other.

We believe organizations grow strongest when people grow well - both personally and professionally.

**Core Values**

At Maxair, our Core Values guide how we work, support one another, and make decisions throughout the organization:

* **ACCOUNTABILITY:** Willingness to take ownership of my own actions and encouraging others to do the same, fostering a culture of responsibility and growth.
* **DRIVE:** The unwavering determination to support those around you, overcome obstacles, and achieve goals.
* **HUMILITY:** Having an accurate assessment of your abilities and putting the interest of the team ahead of your own.
* **INTEGRITY:** Always doing the right thing—even when it isn’t convenient, or no one is watching.
* **PEOPLE FOCUSED:** Prioritizing the well-being and growth of teams, families, customers, and the community, ensuring they feel connected, supported, and valued.

**Summary of Duties:**

The Account Coordinator reports to the Branch Manager and is primarily responsible for assisting the Account Manager team in executing Service Projects for our customers. This position will handle most project back-office processes. You may or may not have direct contact with our customers or field employees depending on the size and complexity of the project.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Planning, organizing, controlling, and coordinating specific aspects of the projects assigned by the account manager.
* Scheduling jobs based on the schedule provided by the owner.
* Managing the necessary administrative records and controls to protect the interests of the corporation and the customer, to include prompt and accurate submittals, maintenance renewals, invoicing and close out materials.
* Forwarding customer concerns and complaints in a timely, efficient, and cost-effective manner to the AM.
* Working with suppliers on pricing, performance, reliability, and availability.
* Performing all duties as directed by the branch manager.
* Overseeing all projects to ensure optimal customer service, efficient use of equipment and time, and meeting departmental strategic and budgetary goals.
* Evaluation of vendor and subcontractor proposals to ensure compliance with the job requirements and specifications.
* Estimating HVAC change orders to comply with corporate profit guidelines and project requirements.
* Coordinate permits and inspections to ensure all project schedules are met.
* Coordination with service department dispatchers to ensure efficient use of technicians' time and effort.

**Secondary Responsibilities:**

* Receiving and managing service customer calls.
* Coordinating the assignment of service technicians to scheduled work orders and emergency service calls.
* Scheduling work orders based on the expected complexity of the call against the capabilities of the available technician.
* Tracking and updating the computerized dispatch board based on work order completion.
* Resolving customer concerns and complaints in a timely, efficient, and cost-effective manner.
* Maximizing the efficient use and allocation of the technician's time.
* Receiving material at the loading dock for the service department.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; use hands, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. Some infrequent lifting is required (less than 40 lbs.)

**Position Type/Expected Hours of Work** This is a full-time position and hours of work and days are Monday through Friday 7:00 am to 4:00 pm. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, pregnancy, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability or covered veteran status.

**Supervisory Responsibility**

None

**Compensation**

* Annual salary + company bonus + vehicle allowance
* Major medical and dental coverage for employee, ability to buy-in for family.
* 10 Days paid time off annually starting 1st January of employment.
  + Pro-rated during year of hire
  + Escalates with tenure, plan details to be shared in writing upon hire.
* Seven paid holidays per year: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day & day after, Christmas Day
* Opportunity to participate in Maxair 401K program.
  + Subject to waiting period.
* Direct access to Maxair management
* Preferred scheduling of paid time off and Maxair sponsored training.

Requirements:

**Required Education and Experience**

* One or more years of combined practical and academic experience in the full range of HVAC sub-fields, including the experience to analyze a typical field situation and provide a timely, correct solution.
* Ability to successfully direct and coordinate the requirements of the customers, employees, outside suppliers, delivery schedules, and subcontractors.
* Ability to negotiate with suppliers and vendors to ensure prompt and timely delivery at the lowest possible price.
* Good oral and written communication skills.
* Leadership and supervisory skills to motivate employees to higher achievements and to keep the company morale high while working with others.

This position is responsible for managing customer accounts and incrementally growing sales within assigned sales channel. This position will develop sustainable relationships with current customers, develop new customers, and grow profitable business significantly over time.

* Grow current customer sales through a variety of sales activities.
* Develop new customers by prospecting customers, qualifying business, making presentations, negotiating relevant items, and successfully overcoming customer rejections to close profitable sales.
* Develop and deliver sales presentations and close sales with existing and new customers.

### **Job Title**

Service Account Manager - Spare Parts

### **Job Description**

**Service Account Manager – Spare Parts**  
**Marietta, GA**

**Up to 10% Travel**

**The Opportunity**

Vanderlande is looking for a **Service Account Manager – Spare Parts** to support the continued growth of our North America Distribution Service business.

In this customer-facing role, you will help customers keep their operations running by ensuring they have the right spare parts available when and where they are needed. You will combine customer relationship management, commercial ownership, performance management, and continuous improvement to help grow and strengthen our spare parts business.

You will work closely with our Spare Parts Operations team, which manages day-to-day order handling and end-to-end fulfillment. While this team owns operational execution, you will represent the customer and business perspective, serve as the first level of business escalation, and continuously challenge performance to help drive our spare parts organization toward operational excellence.

**Your focus will include two key areas:**

* **Spare Parts Packages:** Develop and coordinate spare parts packages for new installations and site launches, helping ensure customers are operationally ready from day one.
* **Spare Parts Replenishment:** Support customers in maintaining appropriate inventory levels through forecasting, planning, replenishment, and ongoing account management.

* Coordinate urgent spare parts requirements and customer escalations, maintaining clear communication and driving actions through resolution.
* Develop quotations and commercial proposals and support customer discussions regarding pricing, scope, and delivery.

* The ability to turn escalations, performance data, and recurring operational issues into structured improvement actions and follow them through to completion.
* Strong planning and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* A hands-on, proactive mindset and willingness to investigate issues in detail when needed.
* Strong communication and influencing skills with the ability to coordinate across teams and stakeholders, even without direct authority.
* Commercial awareness and an interest in developing customer opportunities and growing the business.
* A continuous-improvement mindset and willingness to challenge existing ways of working.
* Comfort working with data to support decisions and identify opportunities.
* Ability to take initiative, make decisions, and follow issues through to resolution.
* Ability to travel up to 10%.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Preferably 2+ years of professional experience in spare parts, aftermarket services, supply chain, logistics, customer service, account management, or a related environment.
* Experience in logistics automation, material handling, e-commerce, warehousing, manufacturing, or another technical or industrial environment.
* Familiarity with spare parts planning, inventory management, forecasting, order fulfillment, or replenishment processes.
* Experience working with operational performance indicators and using data to identify root causes and drive continuous improvement.
* Commercial experience supporting quotations, pricing, customer negotiations, account development, or sales growth.
* Experience working with ERP, CRM, inventory management, or other business systems used to manage customer and supply chain activities.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Pet

**Key Account Manager – Pet Specialty**  
**Location:** Atlanta, GA (In-Office)  
**Reports to:** Sr. Sales Manager  
**Category Focus:** Pet Specialty Channel  
  
**About Inaba Foods (USA) Inc.**  
Inaba Foods is a manufacturer of premium pet food, treats, toppers, and complements, deeply rooted in a family tradition of excellence that spans generations. Since 1958, pet parents have trusted Inaba to deliver products that are human-grade, nutrient-rich, and designed to bring joy to pets.  
  
Today, Inaba is the most popular brand of premium cat and dog dinners and treats in Japan, with growing distribution throughout the United States and globally. Inaba Foods (USA) Inc. continues to expand its footprint, invest in talent, and build long-term partnerships across the pet industry, supported by the stability and vision of our Japanese parent company.  
  
**Position Summary**  
Inaba Foods (USA) Inc. is seeking a Key Account Manager – Pet to develop and manage strategic relationships at the headquarters and regional level with national and regional retailers, as well as distributors, within the Pet Specialty channel. This role is responsible for driving growth, expanding distribution, and strengthening long-term partnerships while collaborating closely with internal teams to execute sales strategies.  
  
This is a full-time, in-office position based in Atlanta, GA, as required by company leadership.  
  
**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

* Grow distribution and sales volume within assigned Pet Specialty accounts
* Strengthen distributor relationships to expand market presence and execution
* Become a trusted partner to customers through strategic planning and consistent engagement
* Contribute to category growth through promotions, pricing strategies, and market insights
* Collaborate cross-functionally to support forecasting, production planning, and account strategy

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers and distributors, nurturing existing business and driving incremental growth
* Analyze historical and current purchase order data to project sales, assess profitability, and identify growth opportunities
* Lead and participate in customer business reviews and market presentations
* Maintain regular engagement with accounts to ensure customer needs are met or exceeded
* Execute promotional strategies and programs to drive volume and brand visibility
* Provide sales forecasts and input for production and demand planning
* Collaborate with executive leadership on pricing, promotions, quotes, and account strategies
* Resolve customer issues related to product, service, or sales execution
* Monitor competitive activity, market trends, and merchandising techniques
* Manage expenses in alignment with budgeted guidelines
* Demonstrate a growth-oriented, proactive sales approach focused on building and expanding strategic relationships
* Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and ethical standards while representing Inaba in a professional manner
* Perform additional duties as assigned

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field
* 3–7 years of experience in sales within Pet Specialty, Food & Beverage, or adjacent CPG categories
* Experience calling on headquarters, regional offices, and/or managing distributor relationships
* Strong ability to analyze trends, data, and sales performance metrics
* Proficiency in creating compelling PowerPoint sales presentations
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and customer service skills
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities
* Experience working cross-functionally with internal teams and external partners
* Ability to travel locally or regionally as needed, including time spent in the field
* Valid driver’s license with a safe driving record, in accordance with company policy
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite or related software

**Why Join Inaba Foods**

* Growing U.S. business with expanding distribution and increasing market presence
* Long-term stability and leadership from a well-established Japanese parent company
* Opportunity to manage meaningful accounts and influence growth strategy
* Collaborative, professional environment with a strong brand reputation

Inaba Foods is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment laws, including California’s Fair Employment and Housing Act.

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Wine & Spirits Macon and Central Georgia
jobs.description:
Description:

A Real Territory. Real Work. Real Upside.

This is a well-developed territory anchored in Central Georgia's core beverage corridor, stretching from Macon across the region's most active retail and restaurant markets through Warner Robins, Perry, and Dublin. The accounts are real, the portfolio is strong, and the market knows Eagle Rock.

What that means for the right person: you walk into credibility. What it doesn't mean: the work is done. Independent retail buyers and restaurant operators in this market have high expectations. Earning their business takes showing up prepared, knowing your products cold, and proving through consistency that you're worth their time. The rep who does that in this territory will build something worth keeping for a long time.

You'll also have something most reps don't: a Team Leader who built this territory over 20+ years, lives in the market, and brings regional oversight experience to everything you do. That knowledge is available to you. What you do with it is up to you.

Requirements:

**Who We’re Looking For**

The split is roughly 70% independent retail, 30% on-premise. This territory rewards someone who takes both seriously:

? **A Retail Seller Who Gets Independent Buyers -** Package stores and specialty wine shops are the backbone of this territory. You need to understand how independent owners think, what drives their decisions, and how to become the rep they call first.

? **Someone Who Earns Trust the Right Way -** Relationships in this market were built over years. You won't inherit them overnight. What you will have is a foundation and a name people recognize. Turning that into loyalty takes showing up, following through, and knowing your stuff.

? **A Self-Starter -** You own the route from day one. No one is going to build your schedule or tell you where to be. The reps who thrive here are the ones who treat the territory like it belongs to them, because it does.

? **Product Credible -** The buyers in this market know wine and spirits. You need to as well, or you need to be committed to getting there fast. Curiosity and preparation go a long way.

? **Coachable -** A 20-year veteran of this specific market is in your corner. The fastest path to growth in this role is knowing when to ask a question and being sharp enough to apply the answer.

? **Licensed & Road-Ready -** A valid Georgia driver's license and clean driving record are required. You'll be covering meaningful ground across Central Georgia every week.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Run the Territory -** Manage a full book of independent retail and on-premise accounts across Central Georgia. The route is yours. The results are yours.
* **Grow Your Retail Base -** Call on package stores, wine shops, and specialty retailers with consistency and preparation. Find gaps in distribution and fill them.
* **Work the On-Premise Accounts -** Maintain and grow relationships with the region's best restaurants. Secure placements, build by-the-glass programs, and show up as a resource, not just a vendor.
* **Merchandise and Execute -** Manage shelf placement, build displays, and bring promotional programs to life across your account base.
* **Prospect Aggressively -** A developed territory still has room to grow. Identify new accounts, open new doors, and expand Eagle Rock's footprint across the region.
* **Use Your Resources -** You have a Team Leader with 20+ years of market knowledge available to you. Use it. The reps who grow fastest here ask good questions and act on the answers.
* **Collaborate Internally -** Work with operations, logistics, and marketing to deliver clean execution from order to shelf.

**What You Get**

* **Commission-Based Compensation -** No ceiling. The territory has real volume and real upside. What you earn is a direct reflection of what you build.
* **Monthly Vehicle Allowance -** We cover your wheels so you can focus on the road ahead.
* **Full Benefits Package -** Medical, dental, vision, and 401(k).
* **20+ Years of Market Intelligence in Your Corner -** A Team Leader who built this territory from the ground up lives in the market and is available to you. That is a genuine competitive edge.
* **Ongoing Training & Development -** Product education, sales technique, and category expertise. We invest in making you better.
* **Exclusive Industry Access -** Producer visits, trade tastings, portfolio events, and direct access to some of the most respected names in wine and spirits.
* **A Culture That Wins -** We work hard, move fast, and celebrate the people who make it happen. Effort is recognized here and ambition has room to grow.

Physical Requirements

*This role involves hands-on account work including moving cases of wine and spirits, setting up displays, and driving between accounts daily. Must be able to lift up to 70 lbs. You'll work across a variety of environments including retail spaces, restaurants, coolers, and storage areas.*

As part of our commitment in creating a fair, efficient, and consistent hiring process we may use artificial intelligence (AI) to help our recruiting teams organize, summarize, and analyze information provided by candidates, including resumes, application responses, and other materials submitted during the application process.AI may be used to identify patterns, highlight relevant skills, and experience, and assist in comparing a candidate’s qualifications with the requirement of a specific role. These tools are to improve efficiency and consistency while supporting more informed hiring decisions, which will ultimately be made by the hiring team.

Wolf Electric Supply Company is an electrical wholesale distributor that supplies electrical contractors with lighting, switchgear, wire, conduit, and other electrical materials for commercial and industrial construction projects. Established in 1986, the company serves the Chicagoland region and supports projects of varying sizes through product sourcing, material procurement, quotations, and delivery coordination.

With access to more than 100 product lines, Wolf Electric Supply helps electrical contractors obtain the materials they need to keep construction projects moving efficiently. Its additional services include fixture storage, wire reeling, and used lighting recycling. The company combines electrical product expertise with personalized service to support contractors, project teams, and construction-related businesses. Wolf Electric Supply Co.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Electrical Project Coordinator to support the coordination of electrical materials, project orders, supplier communications, and delivery schedules. This position is suited to an organized professional with experience or an interest in construction coordination, electrical distribution, purchasing, order management, or project administration.

The successful candidate will help ensure that electrical materials are accurately quoted, properly tracked, and coordinated with customer requirements and project schedules.

**Job Summary**

Wolf Electric Supply Company is seeking an Electrical Project Coordinator to support the coordination of electrical supply requirements for commercial and industrial construction projects.

This position will help manage project-related material requests, quotations, purchase orders, product availability, order status updates, and delivery schedules. Working with inside sales, outside sales, purchasing, warehouse personnel, suppliers, and electrical contractors, the coordinator will help ensure that project materials are processed accurately and delivered according to established timelines.

The role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, effective communication, and the ability to manage multiple project orders simultaneously. The coordinator will also help maintain accurate project documentation, follow up on outstanding materials, and communicate potential supply delays to the appropriate team members.

This is an opportunity for an early-career or developing professional to build industry knowledge in electrical wholesale distribution while gaining practical experience in construction material coordination, procurement support, and project operations.

**Why Join Our Team?**

* Join Wolf Electric Supply Company and build your career in the electrical distribution and construction supply industry. You will gain practical experience coordinating electrical materials, supporting contractor requirements, tracking project orders, and helping commercial and industrial construction projects stay on schedule.

jobs.title: Account Manager -SMB, Growth & Retention (HR Services)
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for a self-driven, growth-minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid- US-based Account Management team. As an account manager at Rippling, you are the CEO of your book of business. You are the primary relationship owner for each of your customers to guide them in optimizing the use of Rippling’s suite of back-office HR products and solutions. You will navigate complex customer issues and priorities and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth. Account managers in our SMB segment own revenue retention and growth of one of our fastest growing customer segments. This is a quota-carrying sales role.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Ensure our customers in the HR Services channel are realizing value and expanding across the platform.
* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, introduction calls, benefits renewal, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.
* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions-based approach
* Navigate a strategic sales process by building relationships with multiple external and internal stakeholders through remote and in-person meetings
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution as part of managing the broader customer relationship
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to monthly targets
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting
* Partner with cross-functional product, support, and customer operations teams to ensure customer success and secure long-term commitments, directly influence Rippling’s product roadmap, and increase operational efficiency
* Take an entrepreneurial approach to the role by being a proactive and strategic partner to customers, tailoring your approach to maximize Rippling product adoption based on each customer’s unique business operations

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2+ years of SaaS experience in account management, sales, or quota-carrying customer success
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license expansion sales are not likely relevant)
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done
* Demonstrated ability to run a consultative discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process
* Proven success building and maintaining long term commercial relationships
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented; great follow-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term
* Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive On-Target Earnings (base salary + sales commission) + benefits + equity. The On-Target Earnings\* for employees will be 60/40 commission split for base/variable pay.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

* Commission is not guaranteed

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
130,000 - 130,000 USD per year(US)  
125,000 - 125,000 USD per year(US)

jobs.title: Major Account Manager
jobs.description:
The Datadog Major Accounts Team is focused on driving new business and expanding the current Datadog footprint with our largest and most strategic clients. The success of the Major Accounts Team directly impacts the success of Datadog and is a highly visible position with bold revenue targets. We are searching for seasoned and successful Account Executives that have a passion for technology and a fast-paced sales environment. The Major Accounts Team has experienced unprecedented success since its inception in 2021 and we are continuing to expand the team. This is a lucrative opportunity for any driven and competitive salesperson.

*At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.*

**What You'll Do:**

* Prospect into a targeted set of accounts while running an efficient sales process
* Nurture existing client relationships and grow the Datadog footprint
* Maintain, build and own specific relationship maps for your territory including existing relationships and aspirational contacts
* Develop a deep comprehension of the customer's business
* Negotiate favorable pricing and business terms by selling value and ROI
* Demonstrate resourcefulness when faced with challenges
* Determine necessary steps to close business and gain customer validation
* Identify a robust set of business drivers behind all opportunities
* Ensure high forecasting accuracy and consistency

**Who You Are:**

* Someone with 7+ years Enterprise software sales experience
* Experienced in selling Fortune 100 companies with the ability to win new business
* Experience managing a complex account team from multiple GTM Ecosystem partner functions to support Sales cycle
* Experience/success selling new solutions into accounts already leveraging core technical products
* Combination of leveraging existing customer contacts and net new PG to break into new BUs and sell net new products
* Have consistently met/exceeded direct sales goals
* Able to demonstrate methodology to prospect and build pipeline on your own
* Experienced in working for an innovative tech company
* Willingness to travel over 50% of the time

  

*Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.*

**Benefits and Growth:**

* High income earning opportunities based on individual performance
* New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
* Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
* Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message
* Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
* An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)
* Access to Inclusion Talks, our Internal panel discussions
* Free, global Spring Health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+
* Competitive global benefits
* Giving programs

*Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.*

**About Datadog:**

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

**Equal Opportunity at Datadog:**

Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our Candidate Legal Notices for your reference.

Datadog endeavors to make our Careers Page accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please complete this form. This form is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

**Privacy and AI Guidelines:**

Any information you submit to Datadog as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Datadog's Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice. For information on our AI policy, please visit Interviewing at Datadog AI Guidelines.

We're on a mission to transform an industry that's been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We're hiring a **Territory Account Manager** at our *Advanced Solutions* rental facility in **Chicago, IL,** and we're looking for someone who's ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. Territory Account Managers will be responsible for expanding our existing customer base by building relationships with contractors and construction company principals. Advanced Solutions branches offer equipment rentals within climate control, compressed air, fluid solutions, power solutions and more.

**Pay:** $150,000 - $600,000 Total Compensation ($40,000 base salary + Uncapped commission with no market restrictions)

### **Primary Responsibilities**

* Territory management of a geographical area. Responsible for the full sales strategy execution from market analysis, sales forecasting, pipeline management and revenue growth, through contract negotiation and customer retention.
* Quickly respond to inbound leads and requests. Familiar with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems.

* Competitive compensation: Base salary plus uncapped commission
* Commission guarantee period while building book of business

* Company provided truck or Vehicle allowance ($800/mo)
* Company provided cell phone or phone stipend
* Relocation assistance (discretionary)
* Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees
* 401(k) and company match
* Generous PTO + paid holidays
* Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)
* Company events and quarterly team activities
* 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home
* Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

### **About You**

You want to be part of a team that's not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we're transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you're excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We're looking for people who:

See challenges as opportunities  

Embrace change and continuous improvement

* Pump, Power & HVAC (power generation, fluid solutions, heating & cooling solutions) Equipment or Industry knowledge (rental or construction) with experience in B2B is sales preferred, but not required (if you're a born salesperson, we'll train you on what you need to know and how to win more business)
* Must be able to lift, carry, and place objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance.
* You have strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills
* You have the technical aptitude to adapt to the fast pace of a growing company and stay continuously educated on the latest EquipmentShare products and services
* You're competitive, self-motivated and results driven, but thrive in a team-oriented environment

That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
==================

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with Scriptly’s pharmacy customers, ensuring they achieve maximum value from our platform.

This role serves as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, driving product adoption, customer satisfaction, and long-term retention. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, has a passion for helping customers succeed, and can effectively communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Engineering, and Support teams to advocate for customer needs and contribute directly to Scriptly’s growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Relationship Management & Onboarding**
----------------------------------------

* **Trusted Advisor:** Own the customer relationship for a portfolio of pharmacy accounts, serving as their primary point of contact and subject matter expert.
* **Onboarding & Implementation:** Lead customer onboarding, ensuring smooth transitions and rapid time-to-value for new pharmacy clients.
* **Business Reviews:** Conduct regular business reviews and check-ins to assess account health, uncover growth opportunities, and address concerns proactively.

**Adoption, Retention & Growth**
--------------------------------

* **Drive Product Adoption:** Train pharmacy staff on new features, product updates, and industry best practices to maximize platform usage.
* **Health Monitoring:** Track customer usage metrics and health scores to identify at-risk accounts early and implement effective retention strategies.
* **Account Expansion:** Partner closely with the Sales team on upsell and expansion opportunities within existing accounts.

**Operations & Cross-Functional Collaboration**
-----------------------------------------------

* **Voice of the Customer:** Advocate for customer needs by gathering direct feedback and collaborating with Product teams to influence the product roadmap.
* **Documentation & Playbooks:** Develop and maintain customer success documentation, best-practice playbooks, and self-serve training materials.
* **Escalation Resolution:** Efficiently resolve escalated customer issues by coordinating across Support and Engineering teams.
* **Marketing Partnerships:** Work with Marketing to identify customer success stories, case studies, testimonials, and referral opportunities.

**Other Duties Assigned**
-------------------------

* Performs related duties in support of department goals
* Assists with special projects and initiatives as needed
* Supports team members and cross-functional tasks during peak periods
* Other related duties as required to meet operational objectives

**Qualifications & Requirements**
=================================

**Required Experience & Skills**
--------------------------------

* **3+ years** of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role in a SaaS or tech environment.
* **Communication:** Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills with proven ability to engage stakeholders across all organizational levels.
* **Analytical Mindset:** Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience using data metrics to drive operational decisions and identify usage trends.
* **Account Management:** Proven track record of managing multiple client accounts, balancing competing priorities, and delivering under fast-paced conditions.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Comfort with software technology and a demonstrated ability to learn new digital platforms rapidly.
* **Personal Attributes:** Self-motivated, highly organized, customer-centric, and committed to working collaboratively within a team-oriented culture.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Prior experience working directly with pharmacy, healthcare, or health-tech clients.
* Working knowledge of pharmacy operations, workflows, and industry standards.

**Pre-Employment Requirements**
===============================

* Must successfully pass a background check prior to start date.

**Performance Metrics**
=======================

Success in this role will be measured by key performance indicators including:

* **Net Promoter Score (NPS)** and customer satisfaction metrics
* **Gross & Net Revenue Retention** across assigned portfolio
* **Product Adoption Rate** and active platform engagement
* **Expansion Revenue** driven in collaboration with Sales

**Location**: Schaumburg, Illinois with hybrid opportunity of 2 days once approved.

**Pay Range:** $60,000 to $70,000 annually

*Final compensation will be based on factors such as experience, skills, and qualifications.*

**We offer a benefits package that includes:**

* Paid leave: Unlimited paid time off per year, which may be used for any reason, in accordance with Illinois and local paid leave laws
* Health insurance: Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Retirement: 401(k) with an employer match
* Paid holidays: 6 company-paid holidays per year
* and more....

**Be yourself at Protolabs**

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a diverse team that feels they are valued in the workplace. So do you feel you do not meet every single requirement but still intrigued? We encourage you to still apply! You can help make our company even better. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, age, mental or physical ability, or any way you represent yourself. We strongly believe diversity makes for more successful teams.

**Why Protolabs?**

We are the leaders in digital manufacturing. We hire doers, makers, and creative thinkers who tackle our roles with an entrepreneurial spirit. Our culture is centered around meaningful work that brings new and innovative products to market at unprecedented speeds. We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do. It’s our people who fuel our creativity and make our culture feel like home.

**Join our team as a**
----------------------

**Customer Success Partner III!**
---------------------------------

*This is a HYBRID role - onsite Tuesday-Thursday if located near Maple Plain, MN or Nashua, NH*

*Must be available Monday-Friday during first-shift hours.*

The purpose of this role is to provide outstanding customer service to both our external customers and internal business partners. An in-depth understanding of all CS processes and service lines is required. They are accountable to identify solutions to meet the needs of our customers while minimizing risk to the organization by providing technical support to the Customer Service team which may include answering process questions, mentoring team members, ensuring documentation is accurate and up-to-date, and delivering training as required. Will also serve as an SME for the full CS organization, representing the team for systems releases and large-scale projects/changes.

### **What You Will Do:**

* Serves as a subject matter expert for the team:

* Collaborate with internal departments; sales, sales management, finance, production and other internal staff to facilitate special and/or unusual requests in order to satisfy customer requests.

* Project manage large customer orders, troubleshoot customer needs

* Consistently and proactively communicates to stakeholders as well as customers

* Creates and sends reporting as required by customers or internal sales partners.

* Accountable partnering with cross-functional teams to ensure large customer projects have been successfully implemented and executed (i.e. monitoring customer forecasts, secondary operations, logistical challenges)

* Experts in all customer Service processes, standard and complex.

* Manages the response in the Ask the Expert Channel: providing answers/direction, looking for triaging and production gaps, and identifying opportunities for process enhancements.

* Responsible for updating procedure documents and work flows as new processes are created or existing processes are updated/changed.

* Manages customer portals: setting up and maintaining portal access.

* Delivers training and delivers on-boarding activities for new employees.

### **What You Bring:**

* BA/BS or equivalent experience.

* Recommended 3-5 years’ Customer Service experience in a manufacturing environment preferred and/or a minimum of two years Protolabs Customer Service experience.
* Strong computer skills (MS Office applications), including experience with CRM and ERP software preferred.

* Consistently demonstrates strong attention to detail, initiative, logic, and resourcefulness.

* Serves as an agent of change, supporting changes and helping the team navigate through change.

* Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally.

* Excellent customer relationship management skills, including the ability to successfully manage customer escalations and focus on customer retention.
