new_jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for a self-driven, growth-minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid- US-based Account Management team. As an account manager at Rippling, you are the CEO of your book of business. You are the primary relationship owner for each of your customers to guide them in optimizing the use of Rippling’s suite of back-office HR products and solutions. You will navigate complex customer issues and priorities and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth. Account managers in our SMB segment own revenue retention and growth of one of our fastest growing customer segments. This is a quota-carrying sales role.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Ensure our customers in the HR Services channel are realizing value and expanding across the platform.
* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, introduction calls, benefits renewal, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.
* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions-based approach
* Navigate a strategic sales process by building relationships with multiple external and internal stakeholders through remote and in-person meetings
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution as part of managing the broader customer relationship
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to monthly targets
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting
* Partner with cross-functional product, support, and customer operations teams to ensure customer success and secure long-term commitments, directly influence Rippling’s product roadmap, and increase operational efficiency
* Take an entrepreneurial approach to the role by being a proactive and strategic partner to customers, tailoring your approach to maximize Rippling product adoption based on each customer’s unique business operations

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2+ years of SaaS experience in account management, sales, or quota-carrying customer success
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license expansion sales are not likely relevant)
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done
* Demonstrated ability to run a consultative discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process
* Proven success building and maintaining long term commercial relationships
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented; great follow-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term
* Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive On-Target Earnings (base salary + sales commission) + benefits + equity. The On-Target Earnings\* for employees will be 60/40 commission split for base/variable pay.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

As a Site Logistics Coordinator, you’ll keep materials, inventory, and shipments moving smoothly across warehouse and transportation operations. You’ll coordinate purchasing, procurement, freight, and order fulfillment while working with suppliers, carriers, warehouse teams, and other functions. Use data and clear communication to spot issues, support sound decisions, and improve day-to-day supply chain performance.

* Advanced skills in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, Copilot and Outlook
* Work independently

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Typically, no less than 5 - 7 years relevant experience

* Must be flexible to travel

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* 5+ yrs. exp supporting senior leadership level executives in large organization or firm
* Project coordination experience

new_jobs.title: Field Marketing Event Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We're redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall's AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We've built a product customers love and a business that's scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.

At Aircall, you'll join a company in motion. We're ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  

**How we work at Aircall**: We're customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you'll feel at home here.

**Why Aircall, Why Now**
------------------------

Help turn a trusted telco brand into a recognizable AI voice product, one event at a time. Rare opportunity, big impact: a startup mindset on top of an established, strong foundation. Aircall is a trusted cloud-based phone solution, with over a decade of global reach across tens of thousands of customers. Over the last year, we've built on that foundation and developed an incredible agentic offering, Voice Agents and Messaging Agents, that helps customers accelerate their AI strategy with an end-to-end, omni-channel voice solution. As we move away from inbound paid search, events are one of the main ways we build pipeline and move the brand forward across the US and Canada. This role makes those events happen.

**About the Role**
------------------

Aircall is looking for an experienced Event Coordinator to join our Field Marketing team and run the planning, logistics, and execution behind our events across the US and Canada.

You will be the person who makes events happen: from executive dinners and roadshows to partner events and larger flagship moments. You will work alongside Field Marketing, Sales, Account Management, and Partnerships counterparts, as well as Performance Marketing, Creative, and Content, so that every event ties to pipeline and brand goals.

We are looking for someone organized, hands-on, and calm under pressure, who takes pride in events that run smoothly and deliver results.  
This role will be hybrid from either our New York or San Franscisco office.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Plan and run events end to end**: coordinate executive dinners, roadshows, partner events, customer events, and larger flagship moments, from first brief to post-event wrap-up.
* **Own the logistics**: manage venues, catering, AV, travel, shipping, signage, and swag, and build run-of-show documents and checklists for every event.
* **Manage vendors and venues**: source, negotiate with, and manage agencies and vendors, and hold them to budget and quality.
* **Track the budget**: monitor spend against each event budget, manage invoices and POs, and flag overruns early.
* **Drive attendance**: manage invitations, registration, and guest lists with Sales, Account Management, and Partnerships so the right accounts are in the room.
* **Be on site**: run events on the ground, including some travel across the US and Canada.
* **Close the loop**: capture attendance and lead data in Salesforce and our marketing automation platform, support timely follow-up with Sales, and report on event results.
* **Work with Creative and Content**: brief event assets, signage, and collateral, and keep event messaging consistent with the brand.
* **Build the playbook**: document processes, templates, and lessons learned so events get easier to run and repeat.
* **Support customer story and partner programs**: help with events that showcase customers and partners.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3 to 5+ years in event coordination, event marketing, or event production, ideally in B2B SaaS or technology.
* A track record of running events of different sizes, from small executive dinners to large conferences or trade shows.
* Strong vendor and venue management skills, including negotiating quotes and managing contracts.
* Comfort tracking budgets, invoices, and POs against event plans.
* Excellent organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage several events at once.
* Clear, confident communication with Sales, Account Management, partners, and external vendors.
* Experience with Salesforce and a marketing automation platform such as HubSpot or Marketo. Event platforms such as Cvent, Eventbrite, or Splash are a plus.
* Calm and resourceful on site, with a bias for solving problems quickly.
* Willingness to travel for events (roughly 20-30%, to be confirmed).
* A plus: experience with events in Canada, or a background in AI, voice, CCaaS, or telco.

**Why join us?**

Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities

‍️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall

Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit

45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset

Competitive salary package & benefits

  

**DE&I Statement:**

At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey.

Frontify is the brand platform behind some of the world's leading organizations, including Microsoft, Telefónica, Bosch, Mercedes-Benz, and Kia. We help every team bring brands to life — with governance in one place, seamless workflows across the tools people already use, and a foundation that's ready for AI.
  
  
We're driven by collaboration, curiosity, and the belief that great work can happen anywhere. What began in St. Gallen has grown to London, New York, and beyond. **What you'll shape**
---------------------

At Frontify, we believe great experiences bring brands and people closer together. As our Events Marketing Manager, you’ll make that happen: creating events that connect our customers, partners, and prospects with the future of brand management. You’ll own how we show up at major industry conferences, our own events, executive roundtables, customer experiences, and partner activations, from the first planning meeting to the last onsite detail.

You’ll work with Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, and Creative to turn ideas into experiences that build real relationships and drive business impact. And you’ll keep finding ways to make the next one even better.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Plan and deliver Frontify-hosted events, executive roundtables, customer experiences, and partner activations, managing logistics from initial planning through onsite execution and follow-up.
* Coordinate Frontify's presence at major industry conferences and third-party events, managing sponsorship deliverables, booth logistics, branding, speakers, and materials.
* Manage timelines, registration, attendee and speaker communications, and onsite logistics
* Collaborate with Sales, Field Marketing, and Partnerships to engage priority accounts, drive attendance, and connect events to business goals.
* Work closely with our Creative team, external agencies, venues, suppliers and production partners to deliver on-brand experiences on time and within budget
* Manage event budgets, purchase orders, and invoices
* Coordinate lead capture and post event follow-up with Sales and Marketing Operations
* Track attendance, engagement, leads, and spend, and use the results to improve future events and our planning processes
* Travel to support events across the US and occasionally internationally, including some evening and weekend commitments around key events.
* Work in a hybrid setup, spending two days per week in our New York City office.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 4+ years of experience in event marketing, field marketing, or event management, ideally within B2B SaaS, technology, or a similar fast-paced environment.
* Experience independently managing event projects or workstreams, from planning and vendor coordination to onsite delivery and post-event reporting.
* A solid understanding of B2B conferences, trade shows, executive events, and customer experiences, with an eye for what makes an event memorable.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to balance multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.
* Clear communication and a collaborative approach to working across teams
* Confidence managing external agencies, suppliers, venues, budgets, and invoices
* An analytical mindset and an interest in using event data, feedback, and performance metrics to understand impact and identify improvements.
* Familiarity with Google Workspace and event or project management tools (Salesforce, Hubspot, and Click-Up a plus).
* An appreciation for great brands, thoughtful experiences, and the small details that make a lasting impression.

**What we offer**

* 401k with 5% matching
* A minimum of 25 days of PTO per year
* Paid educational and wellbeing days off
* Parental, bereavement, and sick leave

new_jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**

The F & B Purchasing & Operations Coordinator supports the Property Chef and Director of Food & Beverage by coordinating daily purchasing, receiving, inventory, and kitchen storage operations. This role ensures that products are ordered according to approved specifications and business needs, deliveries are accurately inspected and recorded, and storage areas remain organized and compliant with food safety standards. The Kitchen Manager works closely with culinary leadership and vendors to maintain product availability, minimize waste, resolve delivery discrepancies, and support food cost controls.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

Inventory/Purchasing:

· Track all invoices for incoming purchased food

· Track price changes on purchased food and report concerns to the chef and F&B Director

· Track waste, transfers, and family meal usage; report concerns to the chef and F&B Director

· Create spreadsheets to track and generate food costs for all venues separately as needed

· Research and facilitate the purchase of new equipment and manage and maintain all warranties

· Maintain positive relationships with all food vendors, equipment & linen supplies, and repair services

· Create and update worksheets to record monthly inventory

· Maintain accurate stock counts, flag shortages and overstock, and complete monthly inventory with culinary leadership.

Operations:

· Coordinate kitchen equipment repairs with repair companies, including research on service contract options.

· Place orders using chef-approved specifications, inventory levels, established pars, and projected business volume.

· Verify quantities, weights, pricing, product quality, delivery temperatures, and expiration dates against orders and invoices.

· Maintain an accurate inventory system by cross-referencing items ordered vs. items received and accurately entering purchase orders in the Birch Street system.

· Reject unacceptable products, document discrepancies, and follow through until credits or replacements are received.

· Notify management team of any receiving-related discrepancies, facilitate request for credit or replacement for damaged or discrepant goods.

· Ensure deliveries are promptly stored, labeled, dated, and rotated; maintain organized refrigerators, freezers, and dry storage.

· Comply with all local Department of Health Regulations regarding Food Handling and Storage

· Facilities Management and Upkeep

· Management of receiving and porter team, creating systems to make these teams more efficient.

· Food product invoice uploading and approval.

· Completes the daily storeroom operations, adhering to established storage, receiving, stock rotation, requisition, sanitation, and security procedures.

· Acts as a liaison between vendors such as pest control, refrigerator, and kitchen equipment repair. Schedules service and maintenance for such things

· Perform other duties as assigned by the Senior Leadership team.

Admin:

· Facilitate collecting recipes to be maintained in a usable recipe database for all venues separately.

· Receiving deliveries

· Entering all F&B invoices into Data Plus

**Qualifications & Requirements**

· Understanding: Ability to read, comprehend, and carry out instructions according to established procedures

· Comprehension: Fluent in the English language

· Organizational Skills: Work efficiently, utilize multitasking, prioritize tasks

· Hygiene and Sanitation: Adherence to uniform, grooming, and personal hygiene standards and expectations per Standard Operating Procedures

· Full awareness of DOH compliance (NYC DOHMH); shall also act as walk-through liaison whilst DOH is on property

· Punctuality: Adherence to posted schedule and arrival time and attendance at mandatory meetings

· Responsibility: Personal comportment in line with Standard, New York policies, standards, and expectations

· Knowledge of BirchStreet (ordering system)

· Able to maintain a high level of confidentiality

· Strong communication (both written and oral) and management skills

· Guest service oriented

· NYC DOH Food Handlers (ServSafe Certificate is a plus)

**Physical Requirements**

· Able to traverse spaces throughout the building as necessary

· Able to work standing for a minimum of 8 hours a day

· Periodic bending, kneeling, and stretching

· Able to pull, push, carry, and lift at least 50 pounds

· Must be able to seize, grasp, turn, and hold objects with hands

**Desirable**

· Previous work experience in procurement management

· ServSafe / Food Handler Certificate

· Multilingual

· Basic knowledge of Excel

Pay: $23.00 - $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

new_jobs.title: Account Manager - NYC
new_jobs.description:
**About F. Schumacher & Co**

Schumacher & Co. is a fast-growing and innovative interior design company. We are a technological leader on the design frontier, constantly pushing boundaries and striving for excellence. We are driven by a shared belief that design transforms life. It challenges convention. It brings a unique point of view into the world. It sets trends. And it leaves a mark. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company of many brands within our portfolio. This role is part of our floorcovering brand, Patterson Flynn.

Patterson Flynn, the rug and carpet atelier, is the ultimate destination for tantalizing products with irrefutable style, premium decorator staples that are the best of their kind, and unparalleled service that is accountable and unconditional.

Our floorcovering brand **Patterson Flynn** is seeking a highly motivated, professional, design savvy Account Manager for our NYC trade - only showroom. The Account Manager represents Patterson Flynn across a geographic territory, bringing our floor covering to the designers and architects shaping the most interesting projects in the market. This is a road-based role. Most of your week is spent where the work happens, in designers' offices, at job sites, and in client presentations, building the relationships that bring new projects our way. This role will be based in NYC, NJ, Connecticut and the Philadelphia metro area.

Responsibilities

Territory and travel

* Own a defined geographic territory and build a weekly plan that keeps you close to your clients.
* Visit designers, architects and project teams at their offices; attend job sites and installations where the project calls for it.
* Analyze the territory to identify growth opportunities among existing accounts and prospects, and prioritize where your time goes.
* Introduce Patterson Flynn to firms who have not yet worked with us, and reconnect with those we have not seen in a while.

Selling and specification

* Maximize sales across all Patterson Flynn categories, including broadloom, custom rugs, and the labor and installation that goes with them.
* Present collections and line shows in a way that is tailored to each client's work and style. Prepare comprehensive proposals and quotes specific to the project, and see them through to close.
* Maintain current knowledge of product, pricing, lead times, competitors and trends, so clients can rely on what you promise them.
* Work with the showroom and workroom teams on samples, custom specifications and installation scheduling.

Pipeline and reporting

* Keep every quote and order current in our sales system, so pipeline and forecast are accurate at any time.
* Stay in regular contact on open quotes.

**This is an entry-level Sales Development role in our NYC office (on-site 5 days a week)**, designed to give you a full understanding of the business from the ground up. You’ll start in a *client-facing position,* helping scale Traba and unlock new revenue opportunities, with the goal of promoting into a *leadership role* or moving *cross-functionally* over time. You don’t need to be passionate about a long-term career in sales — but you do need to be excited about Traba’s mission, embrace spending at least a year in sales, and be deeply curious about understanding our customers.

**More About Us:**

Traba is building a world where the global supply chain operates at peak efficiency. We are a technology company that enhances the productivity and potential of the industrial supply chain by connecting businesses with reliable workers. We leverage location monitoring, predictive algorithms, machine learning, AI, computer vision, and other advanced technologies to drive an unparalleled customer experience. Our mission is to empower both businesses and workers to reach their full productivity and potential. We’re proud to be backed by some of the world’s best investors, including Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst.

**About You:**

First and foremost we are seeking someone who is enthusiastic, **excited about start-ups**, and eager for a chance to grow. We are looking for people who want to help us build something special

* Research and identify potential clients, understanding their business needs.
* Engage with prospects via cold calling, emails, and social media, introducing them to Traba’s innovative solutions.
* Qualify leads and coordinate with the sales team to schedule meetings or presentations.
* Work closely with the sales and marketing teams to develop and refine lead generation strategies.
* Keep accurate records of customer interactions and transactions, recording details of inquiries, comments, and complaints.

* Start-up equity
* Competitive Salary

new_jobs.description:
Position Summary

Corporation Dejavu Cargo Express is seeking an organized and motivated Order Fulfillment Coordinator to help manage the daily flow of orders, packages, and outgoing shipments. This role focuses on keeping order information accurate, coordinating preparation activities, and making sure completed shipments are properly documented and ready for dispatch. The coordinator will work with team members to track order status, address routine discrepancies, and maintain clear records throughout the fulfillment process. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys organizing details, solving everyday problems, and learning more about shipping and logistics operations.

Responsibilities

* Review incoming orders and confirm that item descriptions, quantities, and delivery details are complete.
* Coordinate with the fulfillment team to ensure orders are picked, packed, and prepared correctly.
* Monitor order progress and update records as shipments move through each stage.
* Prepare shipping labels, packing slips, and other necessary order documents.
* Verify package information and check for missing details before dispatch.
* Communicate with team members about order priorities, stock availability, and shipment schedules.
* Investigate routine order discrepancies and help resolve missing or incorrect item information.
* Maintain organized digital or paper records of pending, completed, and dispatched orders.
* Assist with receiving updates about incoming products and changes in inventory availability.
* Help keep order processing organized during busy periods and changing workloads.

Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* No previous experience required; training will be provided.
* Basic computer skills and the ability to enter information accurately.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Clear communication skills and a willingness to collaborate with coworkers.
* Ability to follow procedures, manage routine tasks, and meet established deadlines.
* Dependable, punctual, and eager to learn.

Benefits

* On-the-job training.
* Collaborative work environment.

* 9. Identify discrepancies between requested materials, quoted products, purchase orders, and customer orders; coordinate corrections with the appropriate departments.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager -SMB, Growth & Retention (HR Services)
new_jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for a self-driven, growth-minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid- US-based Account Management team. As an account manager at Rippling, you are the CEO of your book of business. You are the primary relationship owner for each of your customers to guide them in optimizing the use of Rippling’s suite of back-office HR products and solutions. You will navigate complex customer issues and priorities and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth. Account managers in our SMB segment own revenue retention and growth of one of our fastest growing customer segments. This is a quota-carrying sales role.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Ensure our customers in the HR Services channel are realizing value and expanding across the platform.
* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, introduction calls, benefits renewal, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.
* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions-based approach
* Navigate a strategic sales process by building relationships with multiple external and internal stakeholders through remote and in-person meetings
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution as part of managing the broader customer relationship
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to monthly targets
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting
* Partner with cross-functional product, support, and customer operations teams to ensure customer success and secure long-term commitments, directly influence Rippling’s product roadmap, and increase operational efficiency
* Take an entrepreneurial approach to the role by being a proactive and strategic partner to customers, tailoring your approach to maximize Rippling product adoption based on each customer’s unique business operations

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2+ years of SaaS experience in account management, sales, or quota-carrying customer success
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license expansion sales are not likely relevant)
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done
* Demonstrated ability to run a consultative discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process
* Proven success building and maintaining long term commercial relationships
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented; great follow-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term
* Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive On-Target Earnings (base salary + sales commission) + benefits + equity. The On-Target Earnings\* for employees will be 60/40 commission split for base/variable pay.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

* Commission is not guaranteed

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
130,000 - 130,000 USD per year(US)  
125,000 - 125,000 USD per year(US)

Our software supports shop floor and warehouse optimization, data collection, time and labor, labeling, and analytics, with an installed base of hundreds of customer sites. The systems we work in are Infor LN, Baan, Infor LX, BPCS, Infor M3, and Infor XA.

Our clients are discrete and process manufacturers, small and mid-size, domestic and international. We are a small, well-established firm headquartered in Oak Brook, Illinois

**Benefits for Senior Consultant Roles**
----------------------------------------

* Competitive salary
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Life and accident insurance
* 401k with profit sharing
* Paid time off

  

Full Time

### **Inside Sales Rep**

Crossroads RMC is seeking a motivated and results-driven Inside Account Representative to support and grow our Infor LN and Infor LX practices. In this role, you will be responsible for managing existing client relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and selling Crossroads RMC’s full portfolio of ERP services and add-on software applications to both current and prospective clients. You will serve as a trusted advisor to manufacturing, distribution, and services organizations that rely on Infor ERP platforms to run their businesses.

#### **What you will do**

Account Management & Client Engagement

* Manage and nurture a portfolio of existing Crossroads RMC clients running Infor LN and/or Infor LX.
* Conduct regular outreach via phone, email, and virtual meetings to assess client health, satisfaction, and evolving business needs.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, coordinating internally with consulting, support, and delivery teams.
* Document all client interactions, pipeline activity, and account updates in CRM.

New Business Development

* Identify and pursue upsell and cross-sell opportunities within the existing client base.
* Prospect for net-new clients in targeted verticals that are good-fit candidates for Infor LN or Infor LX implementations or migration projects.
* Qualify inbound leads and convert them into active sales opportunities.
* Develop and execute territory and account plans to achieve and exceed revenue targets.

Infor LN & LX Services Sales

* Position and sell Crossroads RMC’s full range of professional services including implementations, upgrades, migrations, and managed services for Infor LN and Infor LX.
* Communicate the value and ROI of Crossroads RMC’s services expertise to prospects and clients at multiple levels of the organization.
* Collaborate with solutions architects and delivery consultants to build proposals, statements of work, and presentations tailored to client needs.
* Stay current on Infor product roadmaps, releases, and licensing models to effectively position services engagements.

Add-On Software Application Sales

* Identify client needs and recommend appropriate add-on software applications that complement or extend the Infor LN/LX platform.
* Maintain in-depth knowledge of Crossroads RMC’s add-on software portfolio and third-party ISV partnerships.
* Conduct software demonstrations or coordinate with pre-sales/technical resources to deliver compelling product showcases.
* Manage the full sales cycle for add-on applications from initial discovery through contract execution.

Forecasting & Reporting

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date pipeline forecasts in CRM on a weekly basis.
* Report on account status, sales activity, and key metrics to sales leadership.
* Participate in regular pipeline reviews, team meetings, and sales training sessions.

#### **What you bring**

* 2+ years of inside sales, account management, or business development experience in an ERP, technology, or software services environment.
* Working knowledge of Infor LN, Infor LX (BPCS), or comparable ERP platforms (SAP, Oracle, Epicor, etc.).
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex B2B sales cycles and multiple accounts simultaneously.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present confidently to stakeholders at all levels.
* Proficiency with CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and standard Microsoft 365 applications.
* Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and commitment to meeting and exceeding quota.

#### **Helpful, but not required**

* Direct experience selling Infor LN or Infor LX services, support contracts, or related solutions.
* Familiarity with the manufacturing, distribution, aerospace, automotive, or industrial sectors.
* Experience selling ISV add-on applications within an ERP ecosystem.
* Prior experience working for an Infor Channel Partner or Value-Added Reseller (VAR).
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field.

Location

Chicago Suburbs, Illinois (Corporate HQ) - Remote and Hybrid options available

Experience

2+ years

Reports To

VP Sales

new_jobs.description:
**We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most.**
====================================================================================================

For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

Generac has an exciting entry level Sales Development Representative position! The Sales Development Representative is responsible for a territory where they are accountable to grow POS sales at the store level. This role educates store associates on Generac’s product lines, answers questions from consumers, and pro’s buying the company’s products and providing support to the dealer channel for specific retail customers’ SF&I programs. The Sales Development Representative works with retailer field leadership to sell new ideas on how to grow the Generac brand across the store.

Compensation for this role: $53,000 plus commission

This position will be supporting one of the following markets:

* Michigan / Ohio
* Florida
* Georgia
* Wisconsin

**Job Description:**

* Drive incremental sales growth by selling all Generac product lines across multiple retail accounts by educating store associates and end users about the company’s products and brand and by using in-depth knowledge of product application and specifications to assist customer in selecting the product that best meet their needs.
* Collaborate with the retail field leadership team to execute new in-store programs to drive awareness and increase sales.
* Collaborate with retail store management to ensure the planograms are executed for portable generators and home standby units and is accurately stocked with Generac products for displays, end caps, buildouts in the stores.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with store managers, key decision-makers, and other relevant personnel in assigned retail locations.
* Maintain and update records of sales activities, customer interactions, and market conditions in Salesforce.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

**Certification / License**

* Valid driver’s license with the ability to travel locally up to 75% of the time

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities**

* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Effective presentation skills for small and large groups
* Strong problem-solving skills
* Ability to work independently
* Ability to make decisions in the best interest of the customer and company
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize activities according to importance and urgency
* Ability to react well under pressure
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and familiarity with CRM software.
* Willingness to travel frequently within the designated region

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear; and use hands to manipulate objects or controls. The employee is regularly required to stand and walk. On occasion, the incumbent may be required to stoop, bend, or reach above the shoulders. The employee must occasionally lift up to 25 pounds. Specific conditions of this job are typical of frequent and continuous computer-based work requiring periods of sitting, close vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
